seam.request: Core parse_request and validate_request own the full strict versioned envelope. Every handler receives schema, stable caller id, operation and arguments with the complete effective request identity. Neither CLI nor MCP reimplements operation semantics.
seam.inventory: Core inventory and request_schema own all public schemas and operation descriptions, including tools.describe content_schemas and every referenced definition from the current shared 57-definition acquired-body catalog, including typed RelationDeclarations and RelationQueryResult. MCP inputSchema is the same full-envelope schema specialized for the named operation; tools/call.params.name must equal request.operation. JSON-RPC id is a transport coordinate, never a substitute effect identity. Adapter schema/dispatch semantics remain unchanged.
seam.outcomes: CoreOutcome has exactly result, artifacts, operation_outcome, refusal and acquisitions. Result is null or exactly artifact/value; refusal is null for returned output and otherwise the exact closed code/reason/gaps/source_refs object. Effects persist_outcome(runtime, fullrequest, outcome) is the sole retention/Response wrapper; integration neither patches final envelopes/provenance nor manufactures an inner judgment, stronger status or semantic acceptance.
seam.effects: Effects execute_effect(runtime, fullrequest, coreplanOrNull) is the sole public-request cross-module effect entry. Core alone produces the exact plan for contract.preflight/work.write; the plan is null for the other named effect operations. Public CLI/MCP never accepts a caller plan. Protected receipts, dispatch/observe/cancel/events and Writer publication remain effects-owned. The separate private fixed ac_support.py _supervise entry calls exactly effects.supervise(runtime, ArtifactRef)->int from its fixed policy/principal/attempt-id/hash coordinates. This resolves only a complete protected reservation, recovers its original full strict request and exact retained Context, and freshly rechecks policy/grant/target/fixed executable/dependencies before the already registered launch. Its int is solely the OS-supervisor exit code, never a method/Worker result; no forged public request, hidden Runtime mode, new public operation or alternate admission is created.
seam.notifications: Grant.notification_sink is required and is the sole existing-sink id selector. Dispatch grants require a nonnull registered id; non-dispatch grants may explicitly use null. Executor/request fields cannot select a sink. Attempt.notification binds sink_id plus the complete exact registered SinkRecord, with the consumer taken only from that record and checked against the packet consumer.
seam.authentication: Only exact final output retained by the registered dispatched Attempt can authenticate a closed return. Caller imports, manual pastes, externally launched CLIs, producer labels or hashes remain raw unauthenticated evidence with producer-binding gaps. There is no external-producer authentication registry or fallback branch.
seam.contract_state: Preflight.contract_state is drafted/admitted/rejected/superseded, distinct from receipt decision and applicable/StaleForUse/unknown. Pure core plans remain drafted; effects commits complete admitted/rejected receipts. Superseded requires a separately trusted exact owner ContractSupersession source, not a caller or successor receipt; no public supersede operation exists and old receipts remain immutable.
seam.wire_status: Persist_outcome owns the closed mapping: returned -> ok/exit0/refusalnull; pre-effect refused constraint/basis/authority/capability -> refused/exit2 with exact refusal; held observation/effect -> error/exit1 preserving uncertainty. Parse/startup/protocol failure has null operation_outcome. A truthful available rejected admission or negative/unknown inner judgment may be returned/ok; timeout with contracted current observation is distinct from an interrupted unavailable output.
seam.capacity: capacity_bytes:null selects no numeric/whole-host fit gate and produces no fit judgment. Exact body bytes and host unknowns survive; ordinary admission remains possible only if the existing grant requires no missing numeric/whole-host fit predicate and all other premises hold. Explicit required capacity cannot be hidden by null. Declared numeric fit measures supported whole-active input or retains indeterminate/falsified; no ratio guess, silent trimming or override-manufactured satisfied result.
seam.errors: Strict startup/request/protocol failure has no activated named-operation judgment. Core support errors and effect failures keep their declared mappings; integration does not classify outcomes by exception message text. Store failure or post-effect uncertainty preserves actual available evidence without rollback or invented completion.
seam.coordination_limit: Incidental Python helper and constructor names may be coordinated after admission. Any material conflict with the accepted policy, method, schema, identity or effect relation returns to Executive rather than changing a peer owner.
